title: Simple Auto Smelt
description: Automatically smelt ores. No furnaces, no fuel, no hassle — just instant smelting for a smoother and faster gameplay experience. Perfect for players who want efficiency without complicated setups.
body:
**Simple Auto Smelt**

**_[WARNING]
This datapack is not compatible with any mods or vein miner datapacks!_**

This datapack enhances your Minecraft experience by automatically smelting ores as soon as you mine them. No need to use a furnace, gather fuel, or wait for cooking — simply break the ore, and it instantly turns into its smelted form. Perfect for speeding up resource collection and streamlining your gameplay, this datapack works seamlessly for iron, gold, and other smeltable items. Enjoy a more efficient and satisfying mining experience without any extra effort.
